But the template search result gave mapped_rxn and template_id 149040. The task now: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-4 to the molecule below". The molecule below? Probably the molecule from previous step? The input from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-3 gave two SMILES; maybe the molecule is the first one? Actually the question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-4 to the molecule below?" The molecule below likely is the one from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-3 answer? That answer gave a list of two SMILES (maybe product?). The template search gave mapped_rxn for template 149040. So we need to apply that template to the molecule (maybe the product) to get precursors. Which molecule? Probably the product is the second SMILES? Wait the earlier answer list: ['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'] This looks like two fragments maybe product? Actually the template seems to involve a sulfonyl fluoride and a silyl group attached to a sugar-like moiety. The product likely is the first SMILES? The second is maybe a side chain? The apply_template we just did on first SMILES gave a tuple of two precursors: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'CC(C)(C)[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F'). That seems plausible: the template splits the silyl group with sulfonyl fluoride.

But we might also need to apply to the second SMILES? Let's apply to second SMILES as well.
